kitDescription: Yukiko is a Fire MG attacker whose kit mixes sustained self-buffs with a Wind-conditional burst payoff. From battle start she permanently gains 55.31% Attack Damage, heals all allies every 3 seconds through her Persona, and re-arms a 15-second 65.37% ATK buff at battle start and every time a Full Burst ends. When she uses her burst she deals 1258.79% of final ATK as distributed damage to all enemies and enters the Scarlet Flower state until that Full Burst ends, during which she heals allies every 3 seconds and gains 90.01% Distributed Damage (her Fire Amp), which boosts her own burst nuke. She also gains 48.15% Elemental Advantage Attack Damage for 10 seconds every time the chain enters Burst Stage 3, which only pays off against Wind bosses. If a Wind Code enemy is present when she bursts, '1 More' triggers: she gains 45.33% ATK for 10 seconds, her Skill 1 fires a 400.31% distributed hit, and her Follow Up would grant 80.25% of her ATK to other Burst-III allies in the Persona state — a target set no current roster unit satisfies.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHAs: every kit line is either FAITHFUL against prose + formula or a verbatim DOCUMENTED_GAP with a recipe, and the S5 blind suite runs GREEN (10 pass / 5 self-documented skips / 0 fail) against the shipped override. The two blind divergences resolve in the driver's favor: the blind's Follow Up encoding drops the Persona-state filter its own flag admits over-credits (the kit's 'except the skill user' + 'in the Persona state' clauses make the target set provably empty on today's roster, so the driver's unmodeled-with-recipe is the faithful read, matching S2b's GAP disposition), and the blind's single-instant Mediarama contradicts the kit's 'Activates every 3 sec' where the driver's 3-tick +3/+6/+9s encoding matches prose and is frame-pinned. Discrimination holds: every load-bearing assertion fails under its named nearest-wrong (battle-start-only ATK, burst-keyed heal cadence, ungated 1 More, amp-as-attackDamagePct, elemAdv-in-DamageUp, gate removal) and counterfactuals assert non-vacuity. Three same-model residuals for the owner to spot-check: (1) the same-cast Fire-Amp-on-nuke ordering — driver pins amp-applies citing the U10 measured rule, but S5 independently judged exactly this MEASUREMENT-GATED and the packet's SSOT only settles earlier-cast buffs and entry auras; S2b's spec supports the driver's direction, so this is a documented, directionally-corroborated pin — one Wind-boss focus-video popup of the nuke with/without the amp closes it; (2) the '1 More = own burst vs Wind' reading converged across all agents but rests on a literal prose read — an ally-sourced/weakness-hit 1 More (Persona team mechanic) would re-key three lines, recipe documented; (3) the blind's flag that hitsPerShot 1 on an MG is a suspicious datamine inherit — base-stat territory, out of override scope, worth a cadence probe before trusting her MG damage share. None of these blocks GO: all are documented, none is an undocumented divergence from prose or formula.
